Interface FileWatcherRegistration

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface FileWatcherRegistration extends AutoCloseable
A registration of interest in a directory, made with a FileWatcher.WatchRequest. Closing it removes the listener; directories no other registration covers stop being watched.

    • close

      void close()
      Closes the registration. Once the method returned the listener is not called again, even when a stage it returned is still pending; unless the method is called from the listener itself, it waits for a call of the listener under way to return, unless the calling thread is interrupted, which stops the wait and leaves the thread's interrupt flag set.
